items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: Emmett Hardy, John, that's something I have heard of. ... I didn't know him.

ctx.x: followed that style. In other words, you can listen to his records and see that the pattern of the Dixieland music and the Rhythm Kings and the Walden's music was there, excepting that he used his own ideas, his solos and his phrasing and things like that, which you couldn't say that that was anything wrong, excepting that it was a great new sound.
Well, Herman, where shall we place Emmett Hardy in relation to Bix?

Emmett Hardy, John, that's something I have heard of. I've often wondered about it. How can you tell? What can you say? I didn't know him. No one had a recording of him, did they? I don't think so, did they? I never found him. They said, Monk Hazel said there was a cylinder disc that was made of him, but no one has ever really found it.
